definitions.explanation: A strap or handle that hangs from above for standing passengers to hold on a train or bus; also a hanging handle on a bag or fixture.

examples.japanese: つり{手|て}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つかまる。
examples.english: to hold on to the hanging strap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、とっさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つり{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}った→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: The train shook, so I instinctively gripped the strap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満員|まんいん}{電車|でんしゃ}→満員電車：08350_manindensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、つり{手|て}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧ほど⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The train was so packed that I couldn't even reach a hanging strap.

notes:
Written {吊|つ}り{手|て} or つり{手|て}, from {吊|つ}る (to hang, to suspend) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (handle). Most often refers to the loop straps hanging in trains and buses for standing passengers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つり{手|て}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つかまる: to hold on to the strap
- つり{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to grip the strap

SIMILAR WORDS:
- つり{革|かわ}: strap hanger — the same train strap, naming the (originally leather) loop
- ⟦{手|て}すり→手すり：12754_tesuri⟧: handrail — a fixed rail, not a hanging strap
